# ================================
# 2) 📌 시그널 함수 (경고 제거 추가)
# ================================
detect_grouped_signal <- function(code, name, sector) {
  tryCatch({

    suppressWarnings({
      price_data <- getSymbols(code, src = "yahoo", from = Sys.Date() - 120, auto.assign = FALSE)
    })

    price_data <- na.omit(price_data)

    cl <- Cl(price_data)
    vol <- Vo(price_data)

    sma5 <- SMA(cl, 5)
    sma20 <- SMA(cl, 20)
    sma60 <- SMA(cl, 60)

    rsi14 <- RSI(cl, 14)
    macd <- MACD(cl, 12, 26, 9, maType = EMA)
    boll <- BBands(HLC(price_data), n = 20)
    cci20 <- CCI(HLC(price_data), n = 20)
    stochK <- stoch(HLC(price_data))$fastK
    atr <- ATR(HLC(price_data), n = 14)$atr

    latest <- nrow(price_data)

    cond1 <- sma5[latest] > sma20[latest]
    cond2 <- cl[latest] > boll$dn[latest]
    cond3 <- macd$macd[latest] > macd$signal[latest]
    cond4 <- rsi14[latest] < 70 & rsi14[latest] > 40
    cond5 <- cl[latest] > sma60[latest]
    cond6 <- vol[latest] > mean(tail(vol, 5), na.rm = TRUE)

    cond7 <- cci20[latest] > 0
    cond8 <- stochK[latest] > 50
    cond9 <- tail(atr, 1) > median(atr, na.rm = TRUE)

    ext_score <- sum(cond7, cond8, cond9, na.rm = TRUE)

    base_passed <- all(cond1, cond2, cond3, cond4, cond5, cond6)

    if (base_passed) {
      tibble(
        섹터 = sector, 종목명 = name, 종목코드 = code,
        RSI = round(rsi14[latest], 2),
        CCI = round(cci20[latest], 2),
        StochK = round(stochK[latest], 2),
        ATR = round(tail(atr, 1), 2),
        확장조건_충족 = ext_score,
        강한후보 = ext_score >= 2,
        날짜 = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }

  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# 3) 📌 전체 종목 스캔
# ================================
all_signals <- purrr::pmap_dfr(stocks, detect_grouped_signal)

signals_basic <- all_signals %>% filter(!강한후보)
signals_strong <- all_signals %>% filter(강한후보)

today_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")

cat("\n📘 [기본 조건 만족 종목 - ", today_str, "]\n")

# 4) 📊 chartSeries 제거 → ggplot 캔들차트로 대체
# ================================
# ================================
# 📌 chartSeries 스타일 3패널 ggplot 함수
# ================================
plot_tech_chart <- function(code, name) {

  chart_obj <- suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages({

      price_data <- getSymbols(code, src="yahoo", from=Sys.Date()-120, auto.assign=FALSE)
      price_data <- na.omit(price_data)

      df <- data.frame(
        date  = index(price_data),
        open  = as.numeric(price_data[,1]),
        high  = as.numeric(price_data[,2]),
        low   = as.numeric(price_data[,3]),
        close = as.numeric(price_data[,4])
      )

      # 이동평균
      df$sma5  <- SMA(df$close, 5)
      df$sma20 <- SMA(df$close, 20)
      df$sma60 <- SMA(df$close, 60)

      # 볼린저 밴드
      bb <- as.data.frame(BBands(HLC(price_data), n=20))
      colnames(bb) <- c("dn","mavg","up","pctB")
      df$bb_up  <- bb$up
      df$bb_dn  <- bb$dn
      df$bb_mid <- bb$mavg

      # MACD
      macd_df <- as.data.frame(MACD(df$close, 12, 26, 9))
      if (ncol(macd_df) == 2) colnames(macd_df) <- c("macd","signal")
      if (ncol(macd_df) == 1) {
        macd_df$signal <- NA
        colnames(macd_df) <- c("macd","signal")
      }
      macd_df$hist <- macd_df$macd - macd_df$signal
      df <- cbind(df, macd_df)

      # RSI
      df$rsi <- RSI(df$close, 14)

      # NA 제거
      df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

      # -------------------------
      # 패널 1: 캔들 + SMA + BB
      # -------------------------
      p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date)) +
        geom_segment(aes(y=low, yend=high, xend=date), color="gray40", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_rect(aes(
          xmin = date - 0.3, xmax = date + 0.3,
          ymin = pmin(open, close),
          ymax = pmax(open, close),
          fill = open < close
        ), color="black") +
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="red","FALSE"="blue"), guide="none") +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma5),  color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma20), color="red", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma60), color="purple", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_up),  linetype=2, color="brown", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_mid), color="black", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_dn),  linetype=2, color="brown", na.rm=TRUE) +
        theme_minimal()

      # 패널 2: MACD
      p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date)) +
        geom_col(aes(y=hist), fill="gray60", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=macd),   color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=signal), color="red", na.rm=TRUE) +
        theme_minimal()

      # 패널 3: RSI
      p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date, y=rsi)) +
        geom_line(color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_hline(yintercept=70, linetype=2, color="red") +
        geom_hline(yintercept=30, linetype=2, color="green") +
        theme_minimal()

      # 결합
      p1 / p2 / p3 + plot_layout(heights = c(3,1.5,1))
    })
  )

  # ⭐ suppress 블록 바깥에서 제목을 추가해야 한다
  chart_obj <- chart_obj + 
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(name, " (", code, ")"),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold"))
    )

  return(chart_obj)
}

# =========================================
# 🧠 1) 스윙 전략 조건 함수 (경고 제거 적용)
# =========================================
detect_swing_signal <- function(code, name, sector) {
  tryCatch({

    suppressWarnings({
      price_data <- getSymbols(code, src = "yahoo", from = Sys.Date() - 120, auto.assign = FALSE)
    })
    price_data <- na.omit(price_data)

    cl <- Cl(price_data)
    vol <- Vo(price_data)

    sma5  <- SMA(cl, 5)
    sma20 <- SMA(cl, 20)
    sma60 <- SMA(cl, 60)
    rsi14 <- RSI(cl, 14)
    macd  <- MACD(cl, 12, 26, 9, maType = EMA)
    boll  <- BBands(HLC(price_data), n = 20)
    cci20 <- CCI(HLC(price_data), n = 20)
    stochK <- stoch(HLC(price_data))$fastK
    atr <- ATR(HLC(price_data), n = 14)$atr

    latest <- nrow(price_data)

    # --------------------
    # 🔥 스윙 조건
    # --------------------
    cond1 <- sma5[latest] > sma20[latest] & sma20[latest] > sma60[latest]
    cond2 <- cl[latest] > boll$mavg[latest]
    cond3 <- macd$macd[latest] > macd$signal[latest] & macd$macd[latest] > 0
    cond4 <- rsi14[latest] > 50 & rsi14[latest] < 70
    cond5 <- cl[latest] > sma60[latest]
    cond6 <- vol[latest] > mean(tail(vol, 10), na.rm = TRUE)

    # --------------------
    # 🔥 확장 조건
    # --------------------
    cond7 <- cci20[latest] > 100
    cond8 <- stochK[latest] > 70
    cond9 <- atr[latest] < quantile(atr, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)

    ext_score <- sum(cond7, cond8, cond9, na.rm = TRUE)
    base_passed <- all(cond1, cond2, cond3, cond4, cond5, cond6)

    # --------------------
    # 🎯 최종 조건 적용
    # --------------------
    if (base_passed) {
      tibble(
        섹터 = sector, 종목명 = name, 종목코드 = code,
        RSI = round(rsi14[latest], 2),
        CCI = round(cci20[latest], 2),
        StochK = round(stochK[latest], 2),
        ATR = round(atr[latest], 2),
        확장조건_충족 = ext_score,
        강한후보 = ext_score == 3,
        날짜 = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }

  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# =========================================
# 🔁 2) 전체 종목 적용
# =========================================
all_signals <- pmap_dfr(stocks, detect_swing_signal)

signals_basic  <- all_signals %>% filter(!강한후보)
signals_strong <- all_signals %>% filter(강한후보)

## # ℹ 10 variables: 섹터 <chr>, 종목명 <chr>, 종목코드 <chr>, RSI <xts[,1]>,
## #   CCI <xts[,1]>, StochK <xts[,1]>, ATR <xts[,1]>, 확장조건_충족 <int>,
## #   강한후보 <lgl>, 날짜 <chr>
# =========================================
# 📊 3) 차트 시각화 (chartSeries → ggplot)
# =========================================
# ================================
# 📌 chartSeries 스타일 3패널 ggplot 함수
# ================================
plot_tech_chart <- function(code, name) {

  chart_obj <- suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages({

      price_data <- getSymbols(code, src="yahoo", from=Sys.Date()-120, auto.assign=FALSE)
      price_data <- na.omit(price_data)

      df <- data.frame(
        date  = index(price_data),
        open  = as.numeric(price_data[,1]),
        high  = as.numeric(price_data[,2]),
        low   = as.numeric(price_data[,3]),
        close = as.numeric(price_data[,4])
      )

      # 이동평균
      df$sma5  <- SMA(df$close, 5)
      df$sma20 <- SMA(df$close, 20)
      df$sma60 <- SMA(df$close, 60)

      # 볼린저 밴드
      bb <- as.data.frame(BBands(HLC(price_data), n=20))
      colnames(bb) <- c("dn","mavg","up","pctB")
      df$bb_up  <- bb$up
      df$bb_dn  <- bb$dn
      df$bb_mid <- bb$mavg

      # MACD
      macd_df <- as.data.frame(MACD(df$close, 12, 26, 9))
      if (ncol(macd_df) == 2) colnames(macd_df) <- c("macd","signal")
      if (ncol(macd_df) == 1) {
        macd_df$signal <- NA
        colnames(macd_df) <- c("macd","signal")
      }
      macd_df$hist <- macd_df$macd - macd_df$signal
      df <- cbind(df, macd_df)

      # RSI
      df$rsi <- RSI(df$close, 14)

      # NA 제거
      df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

      # -------------------------
      # 패널 1: 캔들 + SMA + BB
      # -------------------------
      p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date)) +
        geom_segment(aes(y=low, yend=high, xend=date), color="gray40", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_rect(aes(
          xmin = date - 0.3, xmax = date + 0.3,
          ymin = pmin(open, close),
          ymax = pmax(open, close),
          fill = open < close
        ), color="black") +
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="red","FALSE"="blue"), guide="none") +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma5),  color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma20), color="red", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=sma60), color="purple", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_up),  linetype=2, color="brown", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_mid), color="black", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=bb_dn),  linetype=2, color="brown", na.rm=TRUE) +
        theme_minimal()

      # 패널 2: MACD
      p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date)) +
        geom_col(aes(y=hist), fill="gray60", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=macd),   color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_line(aes(y=signal), color="red", na.rm=TRUE) +
        theme_minimal()

      # 패널 3: RSI
      p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=date, y=rsi)) +
        geom_line(color="blue", na.rm=TRUE) +
        geom_hline(yintercept=70, linetype=2, color="red") +
        geom_hline(yintercept=30, linetype=2, color="green") +
        theme_minimal()

      # 결합
      p1 / p2 / p3 + plot_layout(heights = c(3,1.5,1))
    })
  )

  # ⭐ suppress 블록 바깥에서 제목을 추가해야 한다
  chart_obj <- chart_obj + 
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(name, " (", code, ")"),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold"))
    )

  return(chart_obj)
}


# 👉 강한 후보만 출력
plots <- map2(signals_strong$종목코드, signals_strong$종목명, plot_tech_chart)

plots
